title: Software Architecture Decision Records (ADRs): Documenting Context and Trade-Offs
coreConcept: Structuring lightweight MADR templates (Context, Decision, Consequences, Compliance) to prevent institutional memory loss across engineering teams.
codeSnippet:
# ADR 042: Adoption of Apache Iceberg for Lakehouse Storage
## Status: Accepted
## Context: Hive directory listing overhead on AWS S3 is degrading query planning SLAs.
## Decision: Adopt Iceberg with Apache Polaris catalog.
## Consequences: Positive: O(1) query planning. Negative: Compaction cron jobs required.
